content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets via crypto payments eliminates reliance on traditional payment platforms that charge exorbitant fees. For example, Gumroad takes 10% on every sale, which can significantly cut into your profits. By using NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, you can retain much more of your revenue. This is especially crucial for creators in countries facing financial isolation or currency instability. The ability to sell directly using cryptocurrency not only increases your profit margin but also provides a more resilient structure for your business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling digital products via crypto payments consists of several components working in harmony. First, you set up a hosting solution such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to serve your website for free. Next, you implement a backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment processing logic. Order storage can be managed through Supabase or even Google Sheets. Finally, integrating NOWPayments enables automatic crypto payment verification, ensuring you receive funds without manual intervention. Together, these tools form a sovereign commerce stack that provides autonomy and efficiency.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, where access to conventional payment processors is limited. If you're selling design assets—ebooks, courses, templates, or software—this solution allows you to bypass the high fees and restrictions imposed by platforms like Stripe and PayPal. It's built for those who value ownership, control, and the ability to operate freely in their digital business. By utilizing this architecture, you position yourself to thrive in an evolving digital economy.
Avoid high fees—NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively sell your design assets, you'll need essential components that integrate seamlessly. Start with your hosting service, such as GitHub Pages, to display your products. The backend logic should be handled using tools like Cloudflare Workers, which facilitate on-demand script execution for processing orders. For managing orders, Supabase serves as a robust database solution. Finally, NOWPayments integrates easily to handle cryptocurrency transactions, allowing you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Each component is crucial for a functional and efficient online store.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first create a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your site. Next, write a simple script using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage payments and orders. Set up your database with Supabase or Google Sheets to track transactions. Then, integrate NOWPayments to accept crypto payments securely. Finally, upload your digital products and configure automatic delivery. With these steps, you will have a fully operational online store ready to accept crypto payments in no time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Maintain full control over your digital sales without relying on traditional platforms.

Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your online store. Develop a backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage logic and payments. Set up a database with Supabase or Google Sheets to track orders. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions to ensure seamless payment processing.
